name: event-automation-desktop
description: Standalone desktop version of the SkipBo Event Automation Tool (no Unity Editor, no Python install required).
author: SkipBo Event Automation

scripts.build:py: cd pybackend-src && python -m PyInstaller --onedir --noconfirm --distpath "../pybackend_dist" --workpath "build/pybackend_work" --specpath "build/pybackend_work" --collect-all openpyxl --exclude-module pytest --exclude-module _pytest --exclude-module numpy --exclude-module scipy --exclude-module pandas --exclude-module matplotlib --exclude-module PIL --exclude-module cryptography --exclude-module lxml --exclude-module psycopg2 --exclude-module psycopg2_binary --exclude-module tkinter --exclude-module pydantic --exclude-module pydantic_core --name pybackend_cli pybackend_cli.py
